name: details-target-set-consistency
body:
The durable spec's `details` edge kind refuses a `Note`→`Note` pair at write time, matching the graph projection's deliberate `Note` omission, so the excluded pair has zero admission path (`Note` stays reviewable via the distinct `Reviews` edge kind). This requirement covers that one rule: the write surface admits every other `details` target, and its admitted set carries the projection's target list semantics as a closed, lossless set.

Admissible rule: a `details` edge's target is an authored node — stakeholder/user/requirement/group/entity/value/service/system/container/component/person/constraint, in any layer — or a code FQN (module/file/struct/function); a `Note` (any layer) target is refused. `Note` remains REVIEWABLE — `Reviews` (`Feedback`→`Note`) is a distinct edge kind and stays unchanged (non-goal). Non-`Note` targets stay unvalidated: a stale or dangling `details` target is silent drift, outside this requirement.

The write surface and the projection agree: the `details` arm of `rust.apg.layers.validate.validate_edge` requires a `note` SOURCE and refuses a `Note` target; the projection's `Details` target list (`rust.apg.load.tables.spec_rel_pairs`) keeps `Note` out, so the pair has zero admission and zero loss path.

Acceptance criteria:
- `apg edge add details <note-fqn> <other-note-fqn>` is REFUSED with an actionable error naming the edge kind (`details`), the source, and the target.
- A `details` edge whose target is any other authored node (stakeholder/user/requirement/group/entity/value/service/system/container/component/person/constraint, in any layer) or a code FQN is accepted, and both endpoint files are written.
- The projection side stays UNCHANGED: `rust.apg.load.tables.spec_rel_pairs` keeps `Note` out of the `Details` target list, its deliberate-exclusion comment stays, and the schema carries zero change.
- `Reviews` (`Feedback`→`Note`) is unchanged — `Note` remains reviewable.
- The `unit`-tier test in `src/layers/tests.rs` asserts the `Note`-target refusal while accepting every other authored node and code FQN; it stays in the `unit` submodule per `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries`.
- The load unit test `rust.apg.load.tests.unit.reviews_pairs_admit_note_but_details_still_excludes_it` and the e2e test `rust.artifacts_e2e.e2e.illegal_details_pair_is_projected_away_not_a_binder_error` stay green, untouched.

Scope: the durable `apg edge add` write surface only. The transient plan-JSONL path that projects an undeclared pair away calls `validate_edge` for zero of its rows and stays out of scope; its e2e stays green as-is.
